finding: Both reported actions are Definition-scoped Response Actions whose targetDefinition is mounted by formWorkspace/formSettings. Studio validation and export passed, but the reasoning collector did not count that generic Definition mount.
browserReviewGap: The Forms QueueTable listed existing forms without a row action, so FRM-001 could create but could not find and reopen stored work.
browserReviewRuntimeGap: After create, formWorkspace bound the published runtime resource before publication and produced two /runtime/forms/{newId} 404 errors. The always-visible Open public form action also implied that a draft already had a public runtime.
resolution: Preserved as held evidence. Attempt 12 replays after the Studio mounted-targetDefinition reasoning fix, adds generic QueueTable open actions, renders draft facts only from resource:form, and transitions publishForm to the public URL using its returned formId. Acceptance requires complete=true and a zero-error create-to-publish browser flow.
